title: Celestin and the guitarist poisoned in Jack Carey's band
summary: Miller says he only played second trumpet for Celestin occasionally, then tells of Carey's handsome guitarist.

blocks.x: Well I still can't figure out when Celestan fits in. What did he do?

When you played with Celestan I can't figure out how that fits in. Oh I don't, I didn't play with him steady. That's a couple of times he hired me to play second trumpet. I didn't play with Celestan steady. I see. I know what he did. One time I went to Gulfport, Mississippi with him. Played a dance and I went to Bergaloochee one time with him. But not steady playing with him. I had my own band. I see. Who was that guitar man who got poisoned with Jack Kerr? His name was, oh he was a spook. Now what was that guy's name? Boy he was a big spook. Did I give you his name? No. I forgot his name. But I know he was a big time spook. He was on that one of uh, Gahye. Just on something like Gahye but better looking than Gahye but by that side. He's tall so. And nice looking. He had too many girls you know. He has his keys and one pocket and he has all in another place. Yeah they sure are pointing him alright. Yeah. Now who did it? I don't know but I never know. You can't have too many girls. But look like he could figure that out from where he was then. Maybe.
